name: (ADFS) Reports
description: Storage growth charts, folder size breakdown, and a file dependency graph for managed files. A thin routing-only sub-module whose controllers and forms live in the parent Advanced Filesystem namespace.
project_description: The Reports sub-module of Advanced Filesystem exposes visual storage-reporting pages for managed files. It is a thin module: it ships only routing, menu links and local tasks, and every controller and form it references lives in the parent advanced_filesystem namespace. It adds a Storage Growth report (line chart of managed-file size over time, with settings, snapshot-clear and CSV/JSON export routes), a Folder Size report (per-directory disk usage per scheme), and a File Dependency graph (which entities reference a given file, with a per-file detail page). All routes are registered under /admin/reports/advanced_filesystem/* and gated behind the parent module's restricted 'administer advanced filesystem' permission. The README also describes content-aware private file access, but that behaviour is implemented in the parent module; this sub-module contributes the report routes and their menu/task links.
